GAP-001.exact_rule: Assign average ranks to tied values within S and G separately, then compute Pearson correlation between the two rank vectors. Equivalent to standard Spearman rho with average-rank ties. Do not break ties by condition order, randomize, jitter, or use ordinal/min/max ranks.

GAP-002.exact_rule: Enumerate all 10! permutations of G across the fixed condition order, including the observed labeling. Direction is one-sided positive association. A permutation is at least as extreme iff rho_perm >= rho_obs. For complete enumeration p = count(rho_perm >= rho_obs) / N_permutations. No Monte-Carlo +1 correction. Non-finite rho_obs or any non-finite rho_perm makes the secondary RQ3 analysis NOT_EVALUABLE.

GAP-004.exact_rule: For each featurewise standardized term z_j=(x_j-mu_source,j)/sigma_source,j, use the registered equation when sigma_source,j > 0 and set z_j=0 when sigma_source,j == 0. This applies featurewise to A0, A_mu, A_sigma, and A_mu_sigma. No epsilon, learned fallback, dimension dropping, or DIAG/EVAL decision logic.

GAP-005.exact_rule: If effective_n == 0, set BINOMIAL_RULE_STATUS=NOT_EVALUABLE, effective_successes=0, exact_one_sided_p=UNDEFINED, and support=NOT_EVALUABLE. Preserve effective_n=0, effective_successes=0, and status=NOT_EVALUABLE in the result. Propagate indeterminate state; D or G NOT_EVALUABLE maps to NO SCIENTIFIC ROUTING.

GAP-006.exact_rule: For the four registered semantic classes logic/causality/analogy/definition, BA=(1/4)*sum(TP_c/N_c). This is unadjusted macro-average recall with equal class weights. No frequency weighting, no adjusted balanced accuracy, fixed four-class registry, and deterministic class ordering only for serialization. If a registered class has zero examples in an evaluation subset, STOP_AND_REPORT_PROTOCOL_INTEGRITY_ERROR.
